claim: disrobe reaches 9 of the 9 states the dispatchers of the two committed ollvm-16 -fla functions can select, and reports a named reason for any state it does not reach rather than dropping it.
detail: This is a cover, not an equivalence. The denominator is every state the dispatcher can select, read back out of each sample's own compare tree rather than typed into the gate, so a state the recovery never places stays in the denominator instead of shrinking it. classify_fla.bin declares 4 states and 4 are reached; sumto_fla.bin declares 5 and 5 are reached. The population is two functions built by ollvm-16 -fla and nothing else, so this states nothing about a flattened function this repository does not commit. Behavior is graded separately and more narrowly: a bounded stub_emu differential runs the flattened bytes and the re-emitted recovered bytes on 15 arguments per function, 60 executions in total, and compares the return value against corpus/native/ollvm/probe_src.c. That establishes agreement on those 15 arguments per function and on no other input.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-pass-native/tests/cff_dispatcher_cover.rs reads this file back and asserts both counts against what crates/disrobe-pass-native/src/deobf/cff.rs measures on the committed samples, so the binding runs from the crate to this data. dispatcher_cover_counts_every_state_the_flattened_dispatcher_can_select pins each sample's declared state count and requires every state to be covered, every transition to be resolved and the recovered edge set to pass its check. dropping_one_dispatcher_state_turns_the_cover_gate_red_and_names_it retargets one state store in classify_fla.bin, drops the cover to 3 of 4 and requires the gate to name the missing state, so the gate is not vacuous. a_bounded_differential_agrees_with_the_committed_source_on_every_input_it_runs executes both programs under stub_emu with a 200000-step and 16 KiB-stack budget, and a_seeded_wrong_edge_makes_the_bounded_differential_disagree retargets one recovered edge and requires disagreement on exactly the 6 arguments above ten. the_denominator_is_not_the_tree_walk_counting_itself recounts the same states a second way, by reading every equality compare against the state register out of a linear decode of the whole function, so a compare-tree walk that stopped early would shrink its own denominator and be caught here
measured: 9 reached by the recovered program / 9 states the two committed dispatchers can select

oracle.external: both sides of this ratio are disrobe's. The denominator is read out of the sample's own compare tree rather than typed into the gate, and a second pass re-derives it by scanning every equality compare against the state register in a linear decode of the whole function, so a tree walk that stopped early is caught instead of shrinking its own denominator. That makes the count harder to fake, not externally graded: no other tool supplies the state list. Behavior is graded separately and more narrowly, by executing the flattened bytes and the re-emitted recovered bytes under the in-house x86 interpreter and comparing the return value against corpus/native/ollvm/probe_src.c, the committed C source the fixtures were built from.
oracle.note: The tier is coverage-self-reported because reaching a dispatcher state is not the same as recovering it correctly. Two seeded defects keep the gates from being vacuous: retargeting one state store in classify_fla.bin drops the cover to 3 of 4 and the gate must name the missing state, and retargeting one recovered edge must make the differential disagree on exactly the 6 arguments above ten. The population is two functions from one compiler at one optimization level, 9 dispatcher states in total, and the differential covers 15 arguments per function under a 200000-step and 16 KiB-stack budget. Nothing here states anything about a flattened function this repository does not commit.

title: OLLVM control-flow-flattening dispatcher cover
